_doc: Hand-authored Control Atlas organization, not publisher containment. Defines the Cybersecurity root, nine areas, and each publication's navigation area under docs/DATA_POLICY.md. Every root-to-area and area-to-publication hop is an `organizes` edge with editorial publication status and must never be presented as publisher truth.

_syntheticCatalogsDoc: Publications without an upstream catalog node receive a deterministic `<catalog_id>:CATALOG` root. Only the publisher-native outer level declared here attaches to it. Baselines remain applicability relationships unless their own publication profile defines a native baseline record.
_residualLimbsDoc: Total-trunk-connectivity backfill (owner 2026-07-31: 'everything must connect to the trunk, period'). Catalog_ids here have neither a real nor a synthetic catalog root — they are baseline / applicability sets. Their orphan nodes connect to the trunk via an editorial `organizes` edge to the named limb, satisfying connectivity while keeping baselines OFF the structural spine (they remain Class-2 applicability overlays). Any orphan whose catalog_id HAS a real catalog root is instead backfilled structurally to that root by the build (same-catalog rule); the build fails loudly if ANY node still cannot reach the trunk.
